name: round-transition-agent
description: Automates the end-of-round workflow for music-league-bot: end voting → validate data → generate digest → publish HTML → advance to next round → output sharing messages.
problem: The round transition workflow — end voting, check data, generate digest, export HTML, share the link, advance to the next round — is currently done manually across 10+ UI steps.

trigger.input: league name, league ID, round ID, pasted chat content

criteria: All required data checks pass before generation (submissions, votes, vote comments, round metadata)
HTML export URL returned and accessible (HTTP 200)
League active round advanced to the next round (or reason reported if none found)

versions.v0: Manual trigger; chat content as initial input; HIL pause if data checks fail
versions.v1: WhatsApp automated send (Business API + vault); GChat incoming webhook
versions.v2: Scheduled polling deployment for auto-round-end; automated chat ingestion
versions.v3: Archive generation automation (after content quality improvements)
